Name: Mount Paran
ModernLocation: Unknown; in the wilderness of Paran
Description: A mountain associated with the wilderness of Paran, named in Moses' blessing when the LORD is pictured as shining forth from Paran, and again in Habakkuk's vision of God coming from Teman and Paran.
BiblicalSignificance: Paran is where God's appearing is pictured in poetry, alongside Sinai and Seir.
